lines: Stop trying to be the King if you're a Creator
Some people build what didn't exist before.
caption:
A lot of people chase the King role because it looks like status.

But if you're a Creator, running things will drain you. You need to make something that carries your mark. That's a different kind of status, and it lasts longer.

Are you a King or a Creator?

Comment ARCHETYPE and I'll send you the test 📩
